description.@value: These eccentric and outstanding camping accommodations are designed to offer the highest level of comfort with less to none impact of any kind on the surrounding environment.  Geodesic dome glamping is an ultimate experience, the versatility of these structures allows them to be installed in the most scenic and unlikely locations. From mountain tops, deep in the forest, oceanfront cliffs, in the middle of the dessert, rice field or even snow. Here at DomesVille, these domes were assembled in the foot of a mountain, with a bit of a cliff offering the best scenery of the surrounding hills and the Mt Matutum itself, an overlooking view of the majestic Sarangani Bay as well as the buzzing City of Gensan and of course, the unobstructed view of the fresh pineapple plantation. You can find these latest type of accommodation all over the world, in Australia, China, Malaysia, parts of Europe and Africa, even in the US. Hence, the desire of the owner to bring these kind of accommodation here in the South. These domes also offer a relaxing way and one of a kind experience, that while in the inside, you and your partner can enjoy the unlimited stargazing experience, making promises to one another or planning your future ahead or just chatting to each other, exchanging ideas until you fall asleep,  a truly perfect romantic getaway. Finally, DomesVille Glamping was founded, built and created to let our valued guests experience the UNCONVENTIONAL.
